`appattest-ios-14.4.json` is a real App Attest attestation captured on an iPhone running iOS 14.4
(development environment, app `6MURL8TA57.de.vincent-haupert.apple-appattest-poc`, captured
2021-01-23). It comes from the test resources of
[veehaitch/devicecheck-appattest](https://github.com/veehaitch/devicecheck-appattest)
(`src/test/resources/ios-14.4.yaml`), licensed under the Apache License 2.0. Only the first
attestation sample was copied, unchanged apart from the YAML-to-JSON conversion.
